paragraphs: Krispa. In R' Yohanan's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, beginning of chapter 3; Sanhedrin, Dinei Mamonot, halakhah 2. In Tosefta Shevuot, several rulings are transmitted in his name, citing R' Yohanan [the checked parallel is in Jerusalem Talmud Shevi’it 1:1:3]. ‘A pupil of R' Hiyya the Great said’: there, Ba-Meh Ishah, halakhah 2. R' Berekhya in Kritzpah's name: Midrash Ruth, on ‘And behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem.’ R' Berekhya and R' Kritzpa in R' Yohanan's name: Vayikra Rabbah chapter 4; Midrash Kohelet, on ‘Guard your foot’: Krutzpi. In Jerusalem Talmud, Shevi'it, end of chapter 6; Sanhedrin 3:9 [3:8:4 in the checked edition]; and Ha-Noder Min Ha-Mevushal, halakhah 13: in R' Hananya ben Gamliel's name. He died during the festival's intermediate days: end of Mo'ed Katan. R' Yosi in his name: Ma'aser Sheni 4:3 [4:2:3 in the checked edition]. In R' Yosi ben Hanina's name: Shekalim chapter 7. R' Yonah in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, beginning of chapter 1. It appears that he is R' Keruspedai mentioned in the Babylonian Talmud (see there).
